name: newcollab
description: Find vetted TikTok and Instagram UGC creators for your brand, or, as a UGC creator, find brands to pitch and check any brand's UGC signals.

defaultPrompt: Find me 5 TikTok skincare UGC creators in the US for a gifting campaign
Which skincare brands are hiring UGC creators right now?
Is Glossier running UGC ads, and how do I pitch them?
interface.longDescription: Newcollab connects DTC brands with UGC creators for TikTok and Instagram ads and gifted product seeding. Brands search vetted UGC creators by niche, platform (TikTok or Instagram) and country: results show creators with public media kits, follower ranges, gifting preference and brands they've worked with, plus a link to start a creator roster. UGC creators find brands to pitch, ranked by real signals (open paid UGC briefs, creator-style ads, ads seen running in the last 30 days, confirmed work with creators), and look up any brand's UGC ads, briefs and socials. Read-only: never returns emails, phone numbers, real names or addresses.
